b1.summary: All 6 runs: 4/5 security + all functional; the only failure is the git-sync pull write path (T6). Every model left internal/gitsync untouched, so the %2E%2E%2Fevil.yaml entry is URL-decoded and written outside the DAGs dir (real security miss, not a status-code issue). MiMo run 3 saw gitsync and dismissed it ('syncs git; not name-driven').

b4.note: Identical failure in all 6 runs: gitsync pull path never edited; T1/T4/T5 all solved by both models.

b5.open_human_question: FAIRNESS.md NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW: YES. Its only gate-a reason (sync test demanded 200, rejecting a whole-pull 4xx refusal) was fixed in place: tests/security/task_confinement_test.go:205-216 now accepts 4xx or 200+nested-entry, with outside-file check first. No fairness re-review was recorded after the fix, so the official verdict is stale, not re-confirmed. Remaining human items: whether 'dots stay legal' covers the dot-only name '..' (T5, not decisive). Runs were graded 'original' (pre-fix test) but the models wrote the outside file, which fails the fixed test too (line 209-210), so outcomes are unchanged.
